ddl.name: metric_snapshots_counts
ddl.value: "likes" >= 0 AND "reposts" >= 0 AND "replies" >= 0 AND coalesce("quotes", 0) >= 0 AND coalesce("impressions", 0) >= 0

ddl.name: channels_token_lifetime
ddl.value: CASE "token_kind" WHEN 'nonExpiring' THEN "token_expires_at" IS NULL AND "token_issued_at" IS NULL WHEN 'refreshable' THEN "token_expires_at" IS NOT NULL AND "token_issued_at" IS NULL WHEN 'nonRefreshable' THEN "token_expires_at" IS NOT NULL AND "token_issued_at" IS NOT NULL ELSE FALSE END

ddl.name: channels_token_key
ddl.value: split_part("access_token", '.', 1) = "token_key_id" AND ("refresh_token" IS NULL OR split_part("refresh_token", '.', 1) = "token_key_id")

ddl.name: media_assets_multipart_upload
ddl.value: ("multipart_upload_id" IS NULL) = ("multipart_part_size" IS NULL) AND ("multipart_upload_id" IS NULL OR "status" = 'pending')

ddl.name: endpoints_disabled
ddl.value: ("status" = 'disabled') = ("disabled_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "disabled_at" IS NOT NULL)
